name: Emissions Tracking Agent
headline: Unify emissions evidence without turning screening into a claim
summary: Combine synthetic scope totals, threshold screening, reduction scenarios, and carbon-credit due diligence in one sustainability review while keeping attestations, disclosures, and transactions with qualified owners.
capabilities: Predict failures with real-time analysis and automated planning
Automate permit tracking and renewals with intelligent workflows
Generate audit-ready reports quickly with streamlined data collection
Consolidate fragmented data into real-time insights for easy centralized monitoring
value: Improves visibility across synthetic Scope 1, 2, and 3 evidence.
Supports consistent review of threshold and reduction scenarios.
Protects disclosure integrity by separating analysis from claims, filings, and credit transactions.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

scenarios.title: Emissions Data Analyst: Portfolio emissions evidence
scenarios.prompt: I need a carbon emissions analysis for our Northeast facilities. EPA audit is in two weeks.

scenarios.title: Environmental Compliance Manager: Threshold screening
scenarios.prompt: Screen the Northeast portfolio against its threshold without making a legal compliance claim.

scenarios.title: Decarbonization Program Lead: Reduction scenario planning
scenarios.prompt: What are the top reduction opportunities for the Northeast facilities, and who must review them?

scenarios.title: Sustainability Lead: Offset due-diligence shortlist
scenarios.prompt: Show offset candidates for the projected Boston Hub overage, but do not buy or claim credits.

scenarios.title: Environmental Manager: Phased implementation roadmap
scenarios.prompt: Create the implementation roadmap for our emissions reductions.
